description: This header file 'webpa_pd.h' defines macros and function prototypes related to webpa/parodus log levels and URL retrieval for a C/C++ project. It includes license information, include guards, and an extern "C" block for C++ compatibility.

methods.name: get_parodus_url
methods.description: Function prototype to retrieve the parodus URL. It expects a pointer to a character pointer where the URL will be stored, with a note that the caller must ensure the buffer size is sufficient.
